description: Reviewed, time-bounded exceptions for Swagger-to-gateway contract comparison. Do not list unexplained drift. Wave 2/4 must keep each entry explicit, owned, reasoned, and review-dated.

exceptions.intentional_difference: MCP is a gateway-exported agent surface, not a backend Swagger path.
exceptions.reason: MCP tools are selected at the gateway. Backend Swagger documents REST routes without the product prefix.

exceptions.intentional_difference: Public Beans top-headlines live under /beans/articles/top-headlines; the backend Swagger path remains /top-headlines and the gateway rewrites to that backend route.
exceptions.reason: Gateway product prefix plus the Articles collection grouping; backend registration is unprefixed /top-headlines.

exceptions.intentional_difference: MCP is a gateway-exported agent surface, not a backend Swagger path.
exceptions.reason: MCP tools are selected at the gateway. Backend Swagger documents REST routes without the product prefix.

exceptions.intentional_difference: Gateway Pagination marks limit, next_cursor, and num_results required. Generated backend Swagger lists the same properties without a required array.
exceptions.reason: Public OAS is explicit about required pagination fields. Swaggo output currently omits required on router.Pagination even though the runtime envelope includes those keys.

exceptions.intentional_difference: HTTP 401 is issued by the Zuplo gateway for missing or invalid Bearer keys. Backend Swagger does not document 401 because the Go service does not authenticate public clients.
exceptions.reason: Gateway OpenAPI documents Zuplo RFC 7807 Problem Details for 401. Swaggo output only includes backend application errors.

exceptions.intentional_difference: HTTP 429 is issued by the Zuplo gateway for per-minute rate limits and monthly quota. Backend Swagger does not document 429 because the Go service does not enforce those limits.
exceptions.reason: Gateway OpenAPI documents Zuplo RFC 7807 Problem Details for 429. Swaggo output only includes backend application errors.
